consequence.statement: This is a new opt-in notation. Nested variable substitution is still the default, so nothing changes for an operator who doesn't use `{{- ... }}`.

assertion.statement: Kyverno 1.13.0 adds the `{{- ... }}` notation for shallow (one-time-only) variable substitution, so policies can opt out of Kyverno's default nested substitution, for example to insert HCL that contains `{{ }}`.
